name: Neighbors by the Water
jem_summary: Set a Ribbit’s new home using amethyst and observe a native gardener watering a nearby crop.

pages.title: Neighbors by the Water
pages.text: Set a Ribbit’s new home using amethyst and observe a native gardener watering a nearby crop.

pages.title: Neighbors by the Water
pages.text: Lilypads and umbrella leaves furnish the water and banks around the neighbor’s actual new home.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Bring a Ribbit to a prepared site and use amethyst. Put crops beside a gardener; sorcerers can offer buffs. Neither a blessing nor waiting all night is an additional hidden requirement.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Move a Ribbit to its new home position and right click it with amethyst. Its home point resets so night-time homing uses the new location.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Keep gardener Ribbits near crops and interact with the village support roles. Gardeners water crops and sorcerers can give the player buffs.
